audit.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import ast, hashlib, json, pathlib, subprocess
root=pathlib.Path(".").resolve()
canonical=json.loads((root/"docs/evidence/2026-09-10-v1-05c2d1-native-post-script-supervision.json").read_bytes())
sha=lambda raw:hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
assert canonical["whole_v1_complete"] is False
for ref in canonical["references"]:
    raw=(root/ref["path"]).read_bytes()
    assert sha(raw)==ref["sha256"], ref["path"]
inventory=json.loads((root/canonical["inventory"]["path"]).read_bytes())
epoch=inventory["final_epoch"]
counts={}
for name,folder,commit in (
 ("core",root,canonical["code_commit"]),
 ("pro",root.parent/"orze-pro",inventory["pro_source_commit"]),
):
    assert epoch["pre"][name]==epoch["post"][name]
    expected=epoch["post"][name]
    actual=[]
    paths=subprocess.check_output(["git","ls-files","-c","-o","--exclude-standard","-z","--","src","tests","pyproject.toml"],cwd=folder).split(b"\0")
    for p in sorted(set(item.decode() for item in paths if item)):
        actual.append({"path":p,"sha256":sha((folder/p).read_bytes())})
    assert actual==expected,name
    subprocess.run(["git","diff","--exit-code",commit,"--","src","tests","pyproject.toml"],cwd=folder,check=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
    assert subprocess.check_output(["git","ls-files","-o","--exclude-standard","--","src","tests","pyproject.toml"],cwd=folder)==b""
    counts[name]=len(actual)
subprocess.run(["git","merge-base","--is-ancestor",canonical["code_commit"],"HEAD"],check=True)
for item in canonical["changed_source_test_files"]:
    committed=subprocess.check_output(["git","show",canonical["code_commit"]+":"+item["path"]])
    assert sha(committed)==item["sha256"]
root_report=json.loads((root/canonical["root_validation"]["path"]).read_bytes())
for snapshot in root_report["static_audit"]["snapshots"]:
    raw=(root/snapshot["path"]).read_bytes()
    assert sha(raw)==snapshot["sha256"] and len(raw)==snapshot["bytes"]
    ast.parse(raw)
assert sum(canonical["case_classification"][key] for key in (
 "preceding_commit_public_behavior_failures","preceding_commit_controls",
 "new_invalid_budget_requirements","new_mechanisms","draft_behavior_failures"))==34
print(json.dumps({"references_verified":len(canonical["references"]),"source_test_files":counts,
 "all_pre_post_current_and_fixed_commit_equal":True,
 "changed_source_test_files":len(canonical["changed_source_test_files"]),
 "complete_snapshots":len(root_report["static_audit"]["snapshots"]),
 "whole_v1_complete":False},indent=2))
PY
